name: Lift.exists_tameChart
summary: Take ϖ with ϖ^e = p and a chart with coordinate [u], u^♯ = ϖ; let Γ' be the preimage of the open subgroup U fixing Λ (cyclotomic character mod N = p^f − 1 trivial) and ϖ — normal because an element fixing ϖ and μ_N fixes every conjugate gϖ ∈ μ_N·ϖ (the fixer of ϖ alone need not be normal), of index prime to p because G_p/U has exponent dividing f·N; inertia moves [u] to [ζu] for a primitive e-th root ζ, which gives the tame generator.

steps.lean: obtain n := @not_dvd_pow_sub_one p _ f, NeZero.mk (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero NeZero.out he)

steps.claim: Choose ϖ ∈ Q̄_p with ϖ^e = p and a primitive e-th root of unity a in F_{p^f} (e ∣ p^f − 1).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨ϖ, hϖ⟩, a, Z⟩ := IsSepClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq (p : PadicAlgCl p) e,
    (HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.of_dvd (flatFq f) he).1

steps.claim: A chart c over Λ = W(F_{p^f}) with coordinate z = [u], u^♯ = ϖ, index e and unit series −1 (exists_chart_of_pow_mul_eq_neg: ϖ^e·(−1) = −p).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨c, rfl, _, _, ⟨⟨⟩⟩⟩ := (@exists_chart_of_pow_mul_eq_neg p _ f ⟨ϖ, by
    simp [le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ (NeZero.ne e), ← norm_pow, *, norm_p_lt_one.le]⟩ e (-1)
    (Subtype.ext (by simp [PadicComplex.coe_eq, ← map_pow, *]))).choose_spec.2 (-1) (by simp)

steps.claim: (T) j being surjective, for every v with (v^♯)^e = p some s ∈ Γ has s·[u] = [v] (inertia acts transitively on the e-th roots of p, exists_smul_teichmuller_eq); (q) (gϖ/ϖ)^N = 1 for every g; (K) g fixes Λ iff the cyclotomic character mod N is trivial on g.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨T, q, K⟩ := (hj.exists.1 <| exists_smul_teichmuller_eq _
    (isLocalGalois_padic.exists_inertia_smul_eq_of_pow_eq isUniformiser_ell) c.varpiFlat · c.e (by
    simp [PadicComplex.coe_eq, ← map_pow, *]) ·), (he.rec (by simp_all [pow_mul, div_pow,
    ← map_pow]) : ∀ g : Gp p, (g ϖ / ϖ) ^ N = 1), fun {g} ↦ by simpa using (@cycCharMod_eq_iff
    (Gp p) (PadicAlgCl p) _ _ _ N g _ _ _ 1), (fixes_roots_iff_fixesLambda · |>.1 <|
    apply_eq_self_of_mem_inertiaGroup n ·), ne_zero_pow NeZero.out (hϖ.trans_ne NeZero.out)

steps.claim: Let U = ker(cyclotomic character mod N) ∩ (fixer of ϖ), an open subgroup of G_p.
steps.lean:
let U : OpenSubgroup _ :=
    ⟨(cycCharMod _ N).ker, isOpen_ker_cycCharMod.1⟩ ⊓ ⟨_, isLocalGalois_padic.1.6 ϖ⟩

steps.claim: g ∈ U iff g fixes Λ and θ(z) (FixesThetaZ).
steps.lean:
have M {g} : g ∈ U ↔ c.FixesThetaZ g :=
    (K.trans (fixes_roots_iff_fixesLambda g)).and (by simp [*, c.z_eq_teichmuller, Subtype.ext_iff])

steps.claim: g^N ∈ U for every g with trivial cyclotomic character mod N.
steps.lean:
have Pe {g} h : g ^ N ∈ U := ⟨pow_mem h _, by
    simp [*, @Function.Commute.iterate_eq_of_map_eq _ g (g ϖ / ϖ * ·) fun _ ↦ by aesop]⟩

steps.claim: U is normal: for c ∈ U and g ∈ G_p, g⁻¹ϖ = ζ·ϖ with ζ ∈ μ_N (q), and c fixes μ_N (K) and ϖ, so c fixes g⁻¹ϖ, i.e. gcg⁻¹ fixes ϖ; and the kernel of the cyclotomic character is normal. (The stabilizer of ϖ alone need not be normal; the condition on μ_N is used.)
steps.lean: have : U.Normal := ⟨fun n c g ↦ by have := K.1 c.1 _ (q g⁻¹); simp_all [U, -K]⟩

steps.claim: Take s ∈ Γ with s·z = [a]·z, s in inertia (T with v = a·u), and assemble the tame chart:
steps.lean:
exact (T (a * c.varpiFlat) (by simp [mul_pow, ← map_pow, ← Subring.coe_pow, Z.1])).rec fun s i ↦
    ⟨@.mk _ _
    _ ⟨c, .comap toGp U, U.index_comap_of_surjective hj ▸ .of_dvd_left (IsPGroup.exists_card_dvd_pow
    (⟨1, ·.ind' fun g ↦ by simpa [← QuotientGroup.mk_pow, pow_mul] using Pe (K.2 fun
    _ e ↦ by simp [Function.Commute.iterate_eq_of_map_eq (map_pow g · _) _ (exists_apply_eq_pow n e
    g).choose_spec, pow_right_comm, pow_eq_pow_of_modEq ((Nat.modEq_sub NeZero.one_le).pow _)
    e])⟩)).choose_spec (.pow_left _ (hp.out.coprime_iff_not_dvd.2 (hp.out.not_dvd_mul hf n)).symm),
    by simp [M], hj.forall.2 (⟨⟨·, M.2 ·⟩, rfl⟩), by simpa using ⟨_, U.mem_nhds_one, .rfl⟩, fun l ↦
    by simpa using (T (epsTilt ^ l * c.varpiFlat) (by simp)).imp (by simp_all [↓← theta_smul,
    FixesLambda, c.z_eq_teichmuller, Chart.FixesThetaZ])⟩ _ s Z (by
    induction · <;> simp_all [pow_succ', mul_smul, c.z_eq_teichmuller]
    erw [WittVector.map_teichmuller]; ring!)
    (isWeilPair_zero_iff.2 i.1) (by simp [FixesLambda, *, pow_mem]) ϖ (·.2.2)
    hϖ (n ∘ (.trans · he)) (this.comap _), rfl⟩

steps.claim: the Kummer chart: c with Γ' = j⁻¹(U), of index [G_p : U] (j surjective), prime to p: for every g, g^f has trivial cyclotomic character mod N (on μ_N, g acts by a power of x ↦ x^p, and p^f ≡ 1 mod N), so (g^f)^N ∈ U by step 8 — step 8 needs that hypothesis; g^N ∈ U only for g in the kernel —; hence G_p/U has exponent dividing f·N and its order is prime to p, as p ∤ f (hf) and p ∤ N (n) (p ∤ fN); j(Γ') fixing Λ and θ(z) and the chart a chart of j(Γ') (step 7), Γ' containing a neighbourhood of 1; the prescribed index e divides N (he),
steps.lean:
⟨@.mk _ _
    _ ⟨c, .comap toGp U, U.index_comap_of_surjective hj ▸ .of_dvd_left (IsPGroup.exists_card_dvd_pow
    (⟨1, ·.ind' fun g ↦ by simpa [← QuotientGroup.mk_pow, pow_mul] using Pe (K.2 fun
    _ e ↦ by simp [Function.Commute.iterate_eq_of_map_eq (map_pow g · _) _ (exists_apply_eq_pow n e
    g).choose_spec, pow_right_comm, pow_eq_pow_of_modEq ((Nat.modEq_sub NeZero.one_le).pow _)
    e])⟩)).choose_spec (.pow_left _ (hp.out.coprime_iff_not_dvd.2 (hp.out.not_dvd_mul hf n)).symm),
    by simp [M], hj.forall.2 (⟨⟨·, M.2 ·⟩, rfl⟩), by simpa using ⟨_, U.mem_nhds_one, .rfl⟩,

steps.claim: and for each l an element g ∈ Γ' with g·z = [ε]^l·z (T with v = ε^l·u);
steps.lean:
fun l ↦
    by simpa using (T (epsTilt ^ l * c.varpiFlat) (by simp)).imp (by simp_all [↓← theta_smul,
    FixesLambda, c.z_eq_teichmuller, Chart.FixesThetaZ])⟩

steps.claim: ζ_E = [a] (Z: a primitive e-th root) and tameGen = s with s^k z = [a]^k z (induction on k);
steps.lean:
_ s Z (by
    induction · <;> simp_all [pow_succ', mul_smul, c.z_eq_teichmuller]
    erw [WittVector.map_teichmuller]; ring!)

steps.claim: s is a Weil pair at 0 (inertia), s^k fixes Λ, ϖ is fixed by Γ', ϖ^e = p, p ∤ e (n, he), Γ' normal (step 9); and the index is e.
steps.lean:
(isWeilPair_zero_iff.2 i.1) (by simp [FixesLambda, *, pow_mem]) ϖ (·.2.2)
    hϖ (n ∘ (.trans · he)) (this.comap _), rfl⟩
